summary: First iteration testing of StyleVibe MVP - covered backend (auth, products, cart, wishlist, payments mock, orders) via pytest and frontend (home, search, register, product detail, cart drawer, checkout with mocked Razorpay, wishlist, shop filters) via Playwright. All 18 backend tests pass. All critical frontend flows pass.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr (email-validator) rejects reserved TLDs like .test. Spec says register should work for any valid email; using domain like @stylevibe.test (doc'd in test_credentials.md as buyer@stylevibe.test) returns 422. Recommend updating docs to use @example.com or relaxing validation.
No explicit health endpoint at /api/health. /api/ returns 404; root health is at backend root '/'. Acceptable but adding /api/health would help monitoring.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md (and any UI seed) to use @example.com test domain instead of @stylevibe.test, since Pydantic's email-validator blocks reserved TLDs (.test). Currently the documented test buyer email cannot register through API.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 546 lines and could be split into modules (auth, products, cart, wishlist, orders) for maintainability if it grows further.
POST /api/wishlist swallows ALL exceptions silently (try/except: pass) - should catch DuplicateKeyError specifically; otherwise real DB errors are hidden.

Shipping logic '0 if subtotal >= 999 else 49' is duplicated between Checkout.jsx, CartDrawer.jsx and orders endpoint. Consider centralizing the threshold/value or returning shipping info from a backend endpoint to avoid drift.
DELETE /api/cart uses query params (product_id, size) for body data - works, but a body-based design would be cleaner and consistent with PUT/POST /api/cart.
cart drawer total computed client-side (subtotal + (subtotal>=999?0:49)) — server is the source of truth; may be acceptable for UI preview only.
razorpay import inside the request handler (line 485) - fine, but lazy import means missing dependency surfaces only at request time; explicit dependency declaration would be safer.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@stylevibe.in / Admin@12345 (verified working). Test buyer used: test_buyer_<ts>@example.com / Buyer@12345. Note: documented buyer@stylevibe.test in /app/memory/test_credentials.md does NOT work due to Pydantic .test TLD rejection - main agent should update the docs.
seed_data_creation: Created several test buyer accounts via /api/auth/register with @example.com domain during testing (test_buyer_*@example.com, test_logout_*@example.com). They are persisted in MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~5s and covers all main flows. Use @example.com (NOT @stylevibe.test) for test emails since Pydantic email-validator blocks reserved TLDs. Razorpay is mocked - response id starts with 'order_mock_' and 'mock'==true; frontend Checkout.jsx detects mock=true and skips real Razorpay popup. Order success page is at /order-success and reads from location.state passed from Checkout.jsx. All key frontend selectors are kebab-case data-testid.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical issues found. Only doc-level inconsistency: /app/memory/test_credentials.md mentions buyer@stylevibe.test which fails Pydantic email validation (RFC 2606 reserved TLD). Mitigation: replace with @example.com (already RFC 2606 reserved for examples and accepted by email-validator).
